blogs.title: Meet FeatLLM – Turning AI Into an Expert Feature Engineer
blogs.description: "FeatLLM" rethinks how we use large language models by letting them act as feature engineers instead of black‑box predictors. In this post we walk through why extracting interpretable rules from a few examples unlocks tabular learning even when data is scarce.

blogs.title: "Prompt Perfected" – A Two‑Step Reasoning Journey from Data to Rules
blogs.description: "FeatLLM" uses a carefully staged prompt that first drives GPT to infer causal links between features and the task based on its world knowledge and then applies those insights to concrete examples. We’ll show you how this two‑step approach yields precise tabular rules while avoiding spurious correlations.

blogs.title: "RuleSoup to BinaryBarrels" – Converting Generated Rules into Transformative Features
blogs.description: After GPT spits out text rules you still need usable data columns! This article explains how FeatLLM auto‑generates tiny Python snippets that parse those rules into binary columns that feed downstream models.

blogs.title: "Fast & Light On the Bottom Line" – Why a Simple Linear Weight Is All You Need
blogs.description: "FeatLLM" leverages learned weights over binary rule flags rather than expensive neural nets or repeated LLM calls for every test point. Discover how the linear model captures rule importance in just a few hours while keeping inference latency low.

blogs.title: "From Low‑Shot Seeds To State‑of‑the‑Art Accuracy" – Real‑World Performance Across Tiers
blogs.description: *FeatLLM* stacks up impressively against classical baselines (LogReg, XGBoost), recent few‑shot methods (STUNT), and other LLM parser models (TabPFN). Learn why it can beat full data models with only four annotated samples.

blogs.title: "Bridging Accuracy & Ethics" – What Auto‑Feature Engineering Means for Bias & Fairness
blogs.description: "FeatLLM" taps into the same knowledge base GPT was trained on as it builds decision rules, raising new concerns about inherited bias or misinformation. This post explores those broader impacts and outlines directions for safe deployment in finance or healthcare.
